description: This file defines a factory function to create CRUD controllers for Mongoose models with tenant enforcement, including utilities for sorting, pagination, caching, and error handling.

methods.name: validateSort
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes sort string against allowed fields to prevent heavy in-memory sorts.

methods.name: clampLimit
methods.description: Enforces a maximum page size limit for safety.

methods.name: microGet
methods.description: Retrieves a value from in-memory micro-cache if not expired.

methods.name: microSet
methods.description: Stores a value in in-memory micro-cache with TTL.

methods.name: buildListKey
methods.description: Constructs a stable cache key for list requests based on request parameters.

methods.name: sanitizePayloadWithTenant
methods.description: Sanitizes create/update payloads by removing client-supplied tenant fields and injecting tenantId from request.

methods.name: mergeFilterWithTenant
methods.description: Merges user-provided filter with enforced tenant filter, ignoring client-supplied tenant hints.

methods.name: mapAndReplyError
methods.description: Maps Mongoose errors to user-friendly HTTP responses.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles listing documents with tenant enforcement, filtering, sorting, pagination, caching, and diagnostics.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single document by ID with tenant scope validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new document after sanitizing payload and tenant info.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a document by ID with tenant validation and sanitized payload.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a document by ID with tenant scope validation.
